title: Fourth dimensional mall sphere, has anyone else experienced anything like this?
content: Sorry if this is the wrong place to post this. Sorry if it's long too, I just want to convey the entire thing because everything in it is pretty surreal and felt super vivid all around. I've had liminal space/labyrinth dreams for a long time now and malls and other "corporate" venues have always been a common manifestation of this theme. But this one I had last night was certainly among the strangest, and among the most vivid so I can't really do it justice becuz it's so hard to describe, but I'll try. I dreamed I was with friends in the dream but they were like amalgams of people I knew. They felt as real as my waking life friends though, which makes sense because they were like pieces of all of them. We were hanging out and just having fun in some city for the first half. Somewhere in the city we found and entered this mall complex, like one of those huge malls you'd see in Manhattan. There was like a river flowing through the mall complex and me and my friends were wading through it as the tide got higher the more we explored the mall. All of a sudden two of my friends started fighting and attacked each other and one of them was like overpowering the other and shoving his face under the water. Frantically I jumped in and wrestled to save them, it was such an intense feeling, legitimately indistinguishable from a high octane event irl. After this my friend said by trying to drown my other friend they were trying to save each other and it was supposed to happen and I ruined it. After this we exited the river and explored back corners of the mall, I don't remember much about this part, just that the parts we were exploring here were increasingly eerie, and the walls and carpets were lined in luxurious velvety colors like something in a movie theater, or like the Red Room in Twin Peaks but more neon if that makes sense. Completely dead empty and silent besides me and my three dream-friends btw. I was starting to get a paranoid feeling like my friends were watching me from behind my shoulder and planning to take retribution on me for intercepting their "baptism" or whatever it was. Here's where things get really weird though. I have no idea what happened in the interval but then I found myself separated completely from everyone else with no transition (this happens in my dreams often). I was standing on the floor to the mall and then it phases out and I am now free falling, slowly as though submerged in water but "falling" all the same through what I can only describe as a fourth dimensional Mall Sphere expanding infinitely in all directions. I don't know if it was actually 4D, it probably wasn't and just some third dimensional fascimile of it but the point is that my perspective was completely alien to anything I've felt in reality. The closest I can describe it is that I felt like I was falling down, up, between and through this infinitely expansive row of chain stores and shopping aisles. I really wish I could describe it better but yeah somehow an infinite wheel was manifesting itself in my brain as a vast nothingness of empty malls and food courts. At this point I was waking up but I kept forcing myself back under because this feeling was actually unbelievably welcoming and pleasant, the nightmarish feeling of the first half of the dream had been completely buried and I was just submerged in utter, expansive comfort and bliss in all directions. Bliss was everywhere, but not overwhelming, explosive joy, just this cocoon of balming contentment. Another shift occurred and I thought I was waking up but was still in the dream, my conscious having felt itself emerge and then submerge myself of my own accord once again just to see this through further. I ended up leaving the MallSphere, or at least that iteration of it, and ended up in another corridor. This time it was more like a hospital, and the scary feeling returned as I realized I was much lower to the ground than I am irl, like to the point of feeling like I was some kind of medium sized crawling or slithering animal. There is a nurse in the corridor, and a child she has on a stretcher which she aggressively pushes up the wall, flashing a look of rage at the child that shook me. She looked down at me; a weird feeling went on here; before then I had for some reason intuitively figured that I was imperceptible in this figure, but I was proven wrong as she saw me. She gave me a scowl, didn't say anything and just pushed a finger up to her lip in a "shhh" motion. I ran/crawled/slithered away from her and found myself once again alone in a vast corridor. This time however a pitch black elevator stood open in front of me. I still wanted to stay in the dream and was attempting to do so, even feeling "myself" get up in one side of my brain (though it was in another room than the one I had slept in). Standing before the elevator I realize I can't hold back my body's desire to wake anymore and I step through and get swallowed by the blackness. And finally I woke up for real. The whole dream was strange and features motifs that are present in many of my dreams not just malls (gateways, elevators, water, a woman who has some sort of wisdom I don't etc) but I think for obvious reasons it was the "fourth dimensional" experience of the mall motif in this dream that has really left an impression on me. Especially in how I emotionally reacted to it in the dream and it was a feeling of total peace. Has anyone experienced anything similar to this? I only just discovered this sub today but have long been considering just what dreams truly mean for our consciousness and our universe as a result after having long strings of very profound dreams throughout 2023 and going into this year. . . I really want to discuss these things with people who won't just dismiss all this weird stuff instantly so I'm glad I found this place. Any thoughts you have on this and similar experiences I'd love to hear them.
